grain_rationale: The profile reports row_count 13014 and duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so every source row is a distinct hourly weather observation and one row is one event, which makes grain_type transaction appropriate. No single column is unique on its own (the largest distinct_count is observed_hour_utc at 4341, far below 13014), so identity is derived from the tuple (airport_code, observed_hour_utc): 3 distinct airport codes times 4341 distinct observation hours bounds 13023 possible combinations, which is consistent with the 13014 observed rows. Because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 there are no exact duplicate rows for the identity tuple to absorb and no need to aggregate measures.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: Three-letter code of the airport the observation was recorded at, a labelling attribute with only 3 distinct values (EWR, JFK, LGA) and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp that stamps each hourly observation, with 4341 distinct values from 2013-01-01T06:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00 and samples resolving to whole hours.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: Local calendar date of the observation used for day-level slicing, with 181 distinct values from 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour-of-day label from 0 to 23 across 24 distinct values; it is a numeric label rather than a quantity to sum, so it is a dimension.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in degrees Fahrenheit, a continuous measurement compared and averaged across rows, ranging from 10.94 to 93.92 with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dewpoint temperature in degrees Fahrenheit, a continuous measurement ranging from -9.94 to 73.94 with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage, a continuous measurement with 2178 distinct values between 12.74 and 100.0 and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Compass bearing of the wind in degrees, binned to 37 distinct values from 0 to 360; it labels direction rather than measuring magnitude, and it is nullable (null_rate 0.016828) because direction is not reported for some observations such as calm conditions.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in miles per hour, a continuous measurement from 0.0 to 1048.36058 whose extreme maximum suggests outlier readings; nullable with null_rate 0.000154 for two unreported observations.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Peak wind gust in miles per hour from 16.11092 to 62.14212; largely nullable with null_rate 0.745505 because gusts are only reported when gusting conditions occur.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation accumulated in the observation hour in inches, an additive quantity from 0.0 to 1.06 with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars from 983.8 to 1038.4, a continuous measurement; nullable with null_rate 0.114953 where the station did not report pressure.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Reported visibility in miles, a continuous measurement taking 20 distinct stepped values from 0.0 to 10.0 with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: Full descriptive name of the airport, a label with 3 distinct values such as John F. Kennedy International Airport and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: Municipality the airport serves, a label with 2 distinct values (New York, Newark) and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: Field elevation of the airport in feet, constant per airport with only 3 distinct values (13, 18, 21), so it describes the station rather than measuring the observation.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length in feet, constant per airport with only 3 distinct values (7002, 11000, 14511), so it is a descriptive airport attribute rather than an additive measure.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Ingestion capture timestamp with 3 distinct values between 2026-09-02T23:26:11 and 2026-09-02T23:26:13; it stamps the load batch, not the weather event, so it is a dimension rather than the time column.

category_description: One row is one hourly weather observation reported by one New York area airport station, identified by the airport and the UTC observation hour, carrying the measured conditions at that hour (temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind speed and gust, precipitation, pressure, visibility) together with descriptive attributes of the reporting airport and the local date and hour of the observation.
purpose: This mapping declares how the contracted silver table silver.silver_airport_weather enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category: which column timestamps each event, the grain of one row, the degenerate identity of an observation, and the role and type of every mapped column. It is consumed by the deterministic modeling engine, which generates the gold models from it; no table, view, or transformation is proposed here.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, checked by the validator and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval. Once approved, the modeling engine reads the contract to emit the gold fact and its conformed context, where the category can be joined to operational events such as flights on airport and observation hour.
limitations: The mapping declares structure only: it carries no quality rules, severities, classifications, service levels, ownership, tags, or access policies, and it defines no filters or derived columns beyond the observation_identity tuple. It does not clean the data, so consumers must handle the sparsely reported wind_gust_mph (null_rate 0.745505), the missing pressure_mb (null_rate 0.114953) and wind_dir_degrees (null_rate 0.016828), and the implausible wind_speed_mph maximum of 1048.36058, which suggests outlier readings the mapping deliberately leaves in place. Coverage is limited to the profiled window of 2013-01-01 through 2013-07-01 at three airports (EWR, JFK, LGA), and captured_at reflects load time rather than observation time.
